# requires: transfer
#
# Cancel is the intent a PERSON presses, and it is the one where ignoring the
# field costs the most: the job is not merely restarted, it runs to completion
# and delivers bytes somebody said they did not want. Unlike pause it has a
# terminal ending, so the two are separate branches of honouring and a runner
# can get one right and the other wrong.
submit A size=64 digest=good src=file
claim A alpha 400
intent A cancel
sleep 900
orphans
run A beta
state A

# expect 5: ok A
# expect 6: state=cancelled [DL-R26] [JOB-I9]
# expect 6: done=0
# expect 7: state=cancelled [JOB-S3]
